description:
Sample blueprint for the MQTT edge adapter (AB#7510, Feature AB#6095): one install sets up everything needed
to bring typed MQTT readings from an edge broker into a tenant.

Installs:
- A small sample CK model MqttEdgeSample (ElectricityMeter with five Double attributes) so the sample runs on a
  fresh tenant. Real deployments bind the mesh pipeline to their own CK type.
- An edge deployment site "MQTT edge site" and the MQTT edge adapter (chart octo-mqtt-adapter from the public
  adapter chart repository), hosted on that site.
- The MqttConfiguration "ShrdzmBroker" with PLACEHOLDERS ONLY (host broker.example.com, port 8883, TLS on). The
  broker password is a Secret and is never seeded.
- The DataFlow "SHRDZM smart meters" with two pipelines: the edge pipeline (MqttTrigger@1 on topic
  SHRDZM/+/+/sensor -> typed values -> 30 s buffer) and the mesh pipeline (one ElectricityMeter entity per device
  id + stream data), connected by ToPipelineDataEvent@1. The edge pipeline is linked to the configuration with the
  Uses association.
- The stream-data archive MqttEdgeSampleMeterArchive (Created, not activated).

DELIBERATELY NOT SEEDED: the default deployment site, the Mesh Adapter 670000000000000000000002 and the Helm
repositories 670...003/004/005 belong to the service-managed System.Communication blueprint. The adapter's
pipeline service account is provisioned by the controller after the blueprint is applied.

Prerequisites: Communication and stream data enabled on the tenant (System.Communication >= 4.13, the version
with MqttConfiguration), an edge Communication Operator registered against the edge site, a reachable MQTT broker.

Getting started (the readme of octo-adapter-mqtt has the full walk-through):
1. octo-cli -c InstallBlueprint -b MqttEdgeSample-1.1.1
2. Set host, port, user name and password of the broker on the MqttConfiguration ShrdzmBroker (Refinery Studio
   form; the password with the Secret-aware update, e.g. MCP set_entity_secrets).
3. octo-cli -c ActivateArchive -id 6760711ec4ff02221e0b5a20
4. octo-cli -c DeployWorkload -id 6760711ec4ff02221e0b5a42   (rolls the adapter out onto the edge site)
5. octo-cli -c DeployDataFlow --identifier 6760711ec4ff02221e0b5a30

UpdateBlueprint keeps what the admin entered: host, port, user name and TLS flag of the configuration are runtime
state, the password is a Secret, the archive status is runtime state, and the adapter's chart version and
deployment states are runtime state as well.
